start.title: Memory pairs
start.description:
Cards will appear on the board. Flip two at a time: matching pairs stay face up. Find every pair on the board; when it is cleared and time is left, a new board appears — for a few seconds all cards are face up so you can memorize them, then play continues on the same timer.
You have 60 seconds.

share.lead: Send your personal link and see who finds more pairs in 60 seconds.
